description: This file is a Go source file implementing a fake Kubernetes client testing framework, including object tracking, reactions, and watch mechanisms for unit testing Kubernetes controllers.

classes.name: ObjectTracker
classes.description: Interface for tracking Kubernetes objects in tests.

classes.name: objectTrackerReact
classes.description: Struct implementing reaction logic for object tracker.

classes.name: tracker
classes.description: Struct implementing ObjectTracker, managing in-memory objects, watches, and resource versions.

classes.name: versionedObject
classes.description: Struct storing an object with its resource version.

classes.name: managedFieldObjectTracker
classes.description: ObjectTracker with managed fields support for testing.

methods.name: ObjectReaction
methods.description: Creates a ReactionFunc applying core actions to the tracker.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists objects of a given resource and kind, filtered by namespace.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches objects of a given resource and namespace, optionally delivering existing objects.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific object by namespace and name.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an object or list of objects to the tracker.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an object in the tracker.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing object in the tracker.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Patches an object in the tracker.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a configuration object to the tracker.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an object from the tracker.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Internal method to add or replace objects in the tracker, managing resource versions and watches.

methods.name: addList
methods.description: Adds a list of objects to the tracker.

methods.name: getWatches
methods.description: Retrieves active watches for a resource and namespace.

methods.name: resourceCovers
methods.description: Checks if a resource matches an action based on resource and subresource.

methods.name: assertOptionalSingleArgument
methods.description: Ensures only one variadic argument is provided.
